rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when enhancing a level, quality, status, image, or performance.

example.english: This new feature can enhance the phone’s user experience.
example.traditional: 呢個新功能可以提升部手機嘅使用體驗。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 san1 gung1 nang4 ho2 ji5 tai4 sing1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 sai2 jung6 tai2 jim6

rows.note: Use this when making an existing effect, capability, or feature stronger, especially by adding functionality.

example.english: Adding a night mode can enhance the camera's performance in low light.
example.traditional: 加個夜景模式可以加強相機喺暗位嘅拍攝效果。
example.jyutping: gaa1 go3 je6 ging2 mou4 sik1 ho2 ji5 gaa1 koeng4 soeng2 gei1 hai2 am3 wai6 ge3 paak3 sip3 haau6 gwo2

rows.note: Use this when the enhancement chiefly means increasing the amount, extent, or number of features.

example.english: We will enhance the plan by increasing its members-only features.
example.traditional: 我哋會增加會員專享功能，令個計劃更吸引。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 zang1 gaa1 wui2 jyun4 zyun1 hoeng2 gung1 nang4 ling6 go3 gai3 waak6 gang1 kap1 jan5
